Where Copilot agents live in Microsoft 365 and Azure
How to build one without writing code
The limits you should know about

takeaways: A Copilot agent is Copilot with a job description, your organization's knowledge and a set of tools, so it can act instead of just answering.
Start with ready-made agents or Agent Builder, move to Copilot Studio when you need other systems, and use the pro-code path only when a simple agent cannot do the job.
Keep agents small, grounded in a few trusted sources, limited to least privilege, tested with real questions and supervised by a human, and watch the credit-based cost.
hook: Copilot can now do more than answer questions, and many people are unsure what to hand off to an agent. This Simply Explained episode helps Microsoft 365 users and beginners understand how Copilot agents work, where they live, how to build one without code and which mistakes and limits to avoid.
